assignments.rationale: This occurrence defines the concept of two perpendicular planes. It is a core definition.

This occurrence states a theorem (a condition) for two planes to be perpendicular, based on their normal vectors. It is a different type of knowledge (THEOREM vs CONCEPT) and has a distinct mathematical meaning (a criterion vs a definition). Therefore, it should be split into a separate canonical node.
